title: The Constellation

top_stories.headline: Marta trades Barcelona for Lisbon
top_stories.deck: After six years at the studio she starts a new role in January, and is already hunting for a flat near Príncipe Real.
body: Marta broke the news in the Sunday Riders group on Tuesday: "Signed today. Lisbon from January, send me your flat tips." She has been at the design studio since 2020 and led its move into product work.
She says the plan is to keep riding on weekends and to come back to Barcelona once a month. Two people in the group have already offered to visit in February.
You last spoke one to one in September, about the Girona ride.
top_stories.caption: Lisbon, where Marta lands in January.

top_stories.headline: Pau's startup closes its seed round
top_stories.deck: Eighteen months after leaving his corporate job, the round is done and he is hiring.
body: Pau posted on LinkedIn on Wednesday that the round is closed and that he is looking for a first product designer.
He thanked "everyone who took a call when this was a slide deck". You were one of those calls, in March 2025.

top_stories.headline: Laia and Tom are expecting in the spring
top_stories.deck: The couple shared the news themselves, with a photo of tiny trainers.
body: Laia posted it on Instagram on Friday: "Team of three from April."
Your sister already replied in the family group with six exclamation marks.

editorial: A week of departures and arrivals. One friend is leaving the city, one is starting a company in earnest, and one family is about to get bigger.
It was also a quiet week in your own chats: you replied to most threads within a day, and the two loops still open are both on page 3.

items.headline: Núria graduates in June
items.body: Your cousin confirmed the date in the family group: 26 June, in Valencia. Your mother has asked who is driving.

items.headline: Christmas lunch moves to the 26th
items.body: Agreed in the family group on Thursday, after three days and forty messages.

items.headline: Oriol finishes his first marathon
items.body: 3 hours 58 minutes in Valencia, posted with the caption "never again (until next year)".

items.headline: Sunday Riders plan a December ride to Sitges
items.body: Sara proposed the 13th. Four people have said yes so far; you haven't answered.

items.headline: Inés joins a fintech as Head of Product
items.body: Announced on LinkedIn on Monday. She starts in December.

items.headline: Sam launches a podcast on remote teams
items.body: Episode one is out. He asked his network for guest ideas.

items.headline: Three posts this week on AI agents for small teams
items.body: Two from people you know, one from a founder you follow. All three mention scheduling as the hard part.

items.headline: Álex · 7 months
items.body: No one-to-one chat since April, though you both chat in Sunday Riders. He shared photos from Japan on Monday: ask how it went.

items.headline: Clara · no record of your last chat
items.body: No recent hook. A plain check-in.
